questions.question: What did Balaam do instead of cursing Israel?
Why could Balaam not curse Israel?
options: The angel of the LORD had struck him entirely mute
He could only say what God put in his mouth
He had forgotten the words of the curse
He was too afraid of angering King Balak
questions.answer: He could only say what God put in his mouth

questions.question: Balaam said God is not a man, that he should lie.
Balaam said, "How can I curse whom God has not _____?"
"God is not a man, that he should _____," Balaam declared.
